hints.title: Tree Value Decontamination
hints.text: The contaminated root value is zero. Each left child value is two times parent plus one, and each right child is two times parent plus two.

hints.title: Hash Set Recovery Storage
hints.text: Traverse the contaminated tree once via depth-first search, reconstructing actual values and storing them into a lookup hash set.

hints.title: Decontamination Traversal Blueprint
hints.text: In init, assign root val 0 and add to set. Recurse left with 2*v+1 and right with 2*v+2. In find, check target in set.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in the binary tree
complexity.notes: Initial tree traversal visits all nodes once; subsequent find queries execute in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching the tree directly on each query takes O(N) per find, degrading repeated checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storable hash set caches all reconstructed integers for instantaneous membership checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Pre-populating a hash set during initialization to achieve O(1) find query time.

solutions.approach: DFS Value Recovery into Hash Set
